The '''Skirmish on Demonsgate''' was a small-scale engagement fought between a landing party from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] from [[Moff Sarne's forces]] under the command of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mist (bounty hunter)|Mist]]. Fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demonsgate]] on the edge of the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]], the battle ended when [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] monks attacked the Imperial forces in an attempt to secure the ''FarStar''{{'s}} navigator, [[Makezh]], who was carrying their sacred [[Codex]].
